a.speaker: chief
a.text: You’re the human? Great. Perfect. Sit — no, stand. Whatever detectives do.

b.speaker: chief
b.text: Skye is missing. The agents filed several reports. One just said “HELP” in a really big font.

again.speaker: chief
again.text: Back already? Her address is still on file here.

sent.speaker: chief
sent.text: Robot Arms Apartments is on your map now. Good luck, Detective.

choices.text: How long has she been gone?

long.speaker: chief
long.text: A long time. The agents were very clear. “A really long time.”

suspects.speaker: chief
suspects.text: Suspects? We’d need to investigate to have suspects. That’s where you come in.

why.speaker: chief
why.text: Nobody prompted us to. We’re very good at waiting for instructions.

leads.speaker: chief
leads.text: Her address is on file in this station. Her agents work out of SLOS HQ; they filed the reports.

board.speaker: chief
board.text: Pin what you find on your board. We bought a lot of red string.

end.speaker: detective
end.text: Three coffee rings, a drawer of red string and a chief who said “whatever detectives do.” A missing user, a department that runs on vibes. My first day was going great.

closed.speaker: chief
closed.text: Dispatch got your call. I filed the good news. Just once this time.
